_readme: Attendee-facing schedule for the Creator Carnival, from the run of show. Edit this file and redeploy — no code changes needed. Times are 24h wall-clock at the venue (America/New_York). Deliberately excludes crew-only content (load-in, DJ cue map, mic plan, staffing) and unconfirmed panellists — set lineup_tbc true and leave `people` out until a name is locked. The exhibitor list is NOT here: it is generated from real booth signups in ccc_booth_signups.

event.name: Creator Carnival
event.note: Booths, vendors and activations run all day. The stage schedule is below.

schedule.title: DJ Opening Set
schedule.description: The Carnival kicks off. Music builds the energy as people arrive, shop, explore and connect.

schedule.title: Jump DC — Double Dutch
schedule.description: An interactive jump-rope experience to open the day. Come and get in the rope.

schedule.title: Creator Connection + Carnival Games
schedule.description: Best Dressed, a dance contest, and open creator mixing. This is the block built for meeting people — bring your roster connections into the room.

schedule.title: Line Dancing with Tiara Felder
schedule.description: Led line dancing, open to everyone.

schedule.title: Official Welcome
schedule.description: What Creator Carnival is, what to expect, how to take part, and a walk through the day’s programming.

schedule.title: Bet On Yourself
schedule.subtitle: What happens when you stop waiting for permission
schedule.description: Before you build anything, you have to believe you’re capable of building it.

schedule.title: DJ Break
schedule.description: A musical reset — stretch your legs, walk the booths, meet someone.

schedule.title: Tommy Lynch + Cult Content
schedule.description: A short conversation connecting the Carnival to Cult Content and the wider creative ecosystem.

schedule.title: Build the Brand
schedule.subtitle: Turning creator community into culture + commerce
schedule.description: “I believe in myself — now how do I build something?” Building brands and community, collaboration, and turning creativity into something sustainable.

schedule.title: Roaming Entertainment + DJ on Stilts
schedule.description: A deliberate break from the stage. Magician, balloon artist, mime and roaming performers through the crowd, with a DJ on stilts. The most filmable half hour of the day — shoot it.

schedule.title: BOMESI
schedule.description: The accelerator, access and resources — and what creators can actually do next to position themselves for opportunities.

schedule.title: The Future of Brand Integration
schedule.description: Creators and brands, shoppable content, and where media is going — why creators should be thinking well beyond posting.

schedule.title: From Creator to Bigger Opportunities
schedule.description: You’ve built something, found your voice, created the audience. Now what? Breaking into film and TV, casting, representation, and what the industry actually looks for.

schedule.title: TOB — Live Performance
schedule.description: The Carnival finale. Live performance, sponsor and vendor recognition, closing remarks, and one big final song.
